body: Folks in the US are learning about the Wild Goose Festival (if you don’t, check it out here ). It was modeled largely on Greenbelt, a huge and wonderful festival in the UK. That’s where I’ll be for the next several days. Looking forward to seeing many of my UK (and US, and other) friends there!
